title: Arche Theory 1 (AT1) vs. Dual Arche Theory (AT2)
summary: The foundational conflict between naturalistic Pre-Socratic cosmology (AT1: eternal energy-flow, unified cosmos, no creation ex-nihilo, conservation of energy) versus anthropomorphic dualism and dogma (AT2/DAT).

title: Holographic Matrix Universe & Quantum Mind (HMU / IT)
summary: Spacetime as an informational and energy-field projection where consciousness (p) operates as an embedded receiver-transmitter within the cosmic matrix, integrating Bohm, Wheeler, and quantum non-locality.

title: Critical Epistemology: Know-Know vs. Delusion (k-k / sd)
summary: Rigorous epistemology distinguishing verifiable empirical knowledge (k-k) from social conditioning and self-delusion (sd). Drawing from Socratic questioning, Epicurean empiricism, and George Carlin.

title: Mental Health & Spiritual Evolution (mh+ / p / BDS)
summary: Psychological resilience and alignment with cosmic law (mh+). The transition of consciousness (p) across stages (ava1, ava2, ava3) and the release of pathological delusions.

title: Graded Pedagogical Framework (gr1 / gr6 / gr9+)
summary: Curriculum structuring of deep scientific and philosophical ideas across elementary identity (gr1), intermediate mechanics & logic (gr6), and advanced theoretical synthesis (gr9).
